column1: # toolchains.tsv — the tracked catalogue of host tools whose ABSENCE can make a gate exit 2 (feature 010).
# Population source of the `missing-toolchain` sweep class (docs/zero-gap/sweep-classes.tsv): the class
# probes each row on the host. An absent tool is an Operator-blocked item ONLY when no usable container
# route exists: `container_route` is `none` (the host tool is the only path) or
# `src=<tracked resolver source> bin=<built resolver> build=<build tool> runtime=<rt>[,<rt>...]`, and a
# routed tool is reported only when its resolver source is not tracked, OR it is neither built nor
# buildable (build tool absent), OR none of the runtimes is on the probe PATH. The route check is
# structural (it builds, starts and pulls nothing), so a usable route is not proof the workload succeeds.
# Rows for tools the operator decided to provide as CONTAINER WORKLOADS carry the containerised remedy,
# never a host package (docs/OPERATOR-DECISIONS-2026-09-07.md #10, docs/OPERATOR-DECISIONS-2026-09-09.md #4).
# Adding a tool is a data change here plus the class's corpus; nothing is hard-coded in the class.
# `source` names the tracked document or gate that states the dependency (section, not line number,
# because line numbers drift). Remedies are operator actions and are never run by a sweep.
